description: Returns a comprehensive summary of a UI element, including its DOM context, computed styles, and ranked source code candidates. Works with live Chrome selections or stored thread element_context. This is the primary tool to use when the user wants to modify a UI element.

correlationId.description: The correlationId of a specific selection. If omitted, uses the latest selection.

includePrompt.description: Whether to include a pre-built edit prompt with constraints (default: true).

thread_id.description: A Yocoolab thread ID to use stored element_context instead of a live selection.

name: get_element_context
